## Verification results
- `dotnet build HumanGateway.slnx` — 0 warnings, 0 errors (Protocol → Core → Edge → Relay + 3 test projects + CrashProbe)
- `dotnet test tests/HumanGateway.Core.Tests` — 123 passed, 0 failed (incl. 14 ChunkedTransfer resume/interruption tests)
- `dotnet test tests/HumanGateway.Edge.Tests` — 72 passed, 0 failed (incl. 27 artifact content-endpoint + filesystem-store tests)
- `dotnet test tests/HumanGateway.Relay.Tests` — 75 passed, 0 failed (Testcontainers PostgreSQL via podman DOCKER_HOST socket; incl. 8 ArtifactEndpointTests covering upload/download/dedup/resume/range/size-limit/hash-mismatch/unregistered-gateway)
- Total: 270 tests green.

## Requirement coverage (ARTF-FR-01..03, PROTO-FR-04, SP-06, AUTH-FR-05)
- ArtifactStore port in Core (`IArtifactStore`: SaveAsync/OpenReadAsync/ExistsAsync/GetSizeAsync/DeleteAsync) shared by both implementations (vision §6.3)
- Edge filesystem store: content-hash naming (sha256:hex), atomic temp-file write + rename, dedup on existing path (returns false = deduplicated) and on concurrent-writer race (ARTF-FR-01)
- Relay Postgres BYTEA store: same interface, hash verified BEFORE insert (SP-06), unique-violation backstop for concurrent dedup, streaming reads
- Edge `GET /artifacts/{id}` serving + Relay BYTEA streaming download with manual Range handling over the non-seekable BYTEA stream (PartialContentResult); both gated on gateway auth (AUTH-FR-05, SP-02)
- Resumable transfer: ChunkedArtifactTransfer driver (4 MiB chunks, configurable), offset-addressed idempotent chunks, resume-from-accepted-offset on ChunkOffsetMismatch, Range-resume downloads, hash-verified completion (ARTF-FR-02, artifacts Open Q #1)
- Size limits + per-gateway quotas configurable (50 MiB default artifact, 1 GiB quota; appsettings Artifacts + Relay:Artifacts sections, surfaced to PWA) (ARTF-FR-03, vision Open Q #7)
- Messages reference artifacts by ID + hash via ArtifactReference (id, hash, filename, mimeType, sizeBytes) — never embedded bytes (PROTO-FR-04); metadata travels with the message

## Chaos scenario
- Interrupted-transfer resume: ChunkedTransferTests (Core) + Upload_InterruptedMidWay_ResumesFromTheAcceptedOffset_AndCompletes (Relay) + SyncWorker partial-download temp-file resume — verified by green tests; a live kill-and-resume integration test is a follow-up candidate for the qa-engineer's chaos tier (artifacts §6).
